newsitem.title: CANADA: Canada's Martin eager to remain finance minister.
newsitem.headline: Canada's Martin eager to remain finance minister.

text.p: Canadian Finance Minister Paul Martin said on Thursday he was eager to remain in his current post in the new cabinet to be announced next week.
"Obviously it's the prime minister's decision and I'll do what the prime minister wants, but very clearly I've enjoyed the challenge," Martin told Reuters after a cabinet meeting.
Asked if he was eager to stay on, he said: "Yes".
Prime Minister Jean Chretien's Liberal government was re-elected on Monday with a reduced majority.

There was speculation this week that Martin might be moved out of the finance portfolio, possibly to take the position of intergovernmental affairs minister, which deals with national unity. But Chretien's spokesman, Peter Donolo, said on Tuesday that Martin would likely be reappointed for another term.
Donolo said: "I don't see any reason why he (Chretien) would change his mind."
